infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Aangan uses your location to confirm you are in a live city and to share the visit address with your professional.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aangan uses photos you choose so the professional can see the problem before arriving.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aangan uses the camera so you can photograph the issue for your booking.
